item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Launches New Strikes on Iran
item.summary: The United States and Iran have struggled to begin negotiations to end the war, after nearly four weeks of fighting. There were more drone and missile attacks on U.S. allies in the Persian Gulf on Thursday.

item.title: Trump’s Threats to Europe Put Its Leaders in a Double Bind Over Iran
item.summary: European politicians risk angering their voters if they join America’s war. Yet they could also face domestic upheaval if they take no action to reopen shipping routes that Iran has blocked and ease an energy crisis.

item.title: Cheap Drones Remain Wild Card in Iran war
item.summary: Stopping Iran’s production of drones is critical to opening the Strait of Hormuz and halting its attacks on Gulf nations. But can it be done?

item.title: Trump Says He’s Talking With Iran. Iran Says He’s Not. Here’s Why.
item.summary: The president has domestic and international political motivations for touting negotiations to end the war. Iran has similar ones to deny discussions.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Are Talking About Ways to End the War: What to Know
item.summary: The United States is discussing ways to end hostilities with Iran, even as the Pentagon dispatches more troops.

item.title: Republicans in Congress Fret Over Trump Administration’s Handling of Iran War
item.summary: G.O.P. lawmakers who have given the Trump administration wide latitude to wage war with no congressional input are growing frustrated as officials offer little detail about ground troops, cost or timeline.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Wednesday
item.summary: The fighting continued while conditions for a possible cease-fire were debated.

item.title: Ukraine Finally Got Battlefield Momentum. Now Comes a Russian Offensive.
item.summary: Moscow’s forces are intensifying their attacks in southern Ukraine after Kyiv made rare gains along the front.

item.title: A Missile Fragment in a Schoolyard
item.summary: Examining an image of children near a missile fragment, which landed near a school as several families were sheltering inside it.

item.title: How U.S.A.I.D. Birth Control Meant for Africa Was Ruined
item.summary: The Trump administration had options for offloading contraceptives once destined for Africa, a newly obtained memo shows. Instead, it has let them collect dust and go bad.
